newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian killer wants to return to jail.
newsitem.headline: Albanian killer wants to return to jail.

text.p: A convicted murderer who escaped with hundreds of fellow prisoners when their guards fled during the armed uprising that swept Albania last month was quoted on Thursday as saying he wanted to go back to jail.

The 38-year-old man said in an interview in Tirana's Republika newspaper he regretted killing his wife and vowed he would never commit a crime again. He also hoped to benefit from an amnesty programme for convicts who return freely.
Identified only by his initials, N.K., the man said he hoped to have his life sentence reduced to 20 years by voluntarily returning to jail.
"I am really repentent and I can guarantee I will never commit a new crime," the man was quoted as saying.
All seven of Albania's jails emptied and many were looted last month as anarchy spread across the Balkan nation. More than 1,300 prisoners escaped and so far only about 20 have voluntarily returned.
The all-party emergency government has offered an amnesty programme to convicts who return voluntarily to jail by April 12. They will have their sentence reduced by one-third.
